Metrics.Name: intune.remediation.overview.remediated_device_count
Metrics.Description: Tenant-wide count of devices remediated by health scripts (getRemediationSummary() cross-check).

Metrics.Name: intune.remediation.overview.script_count
Metrics.Description: Tenant-wide count of health scripts deployed (getRemediationSummary() cross-check).

Metrics.Name: intune.remediation.remediated_cumulative_devices
Metrics.Description: Distinct devices remediated by each health script over the trailing 30 days (issueRemediatedCumulativeDeviceCount).

Metrics.Name: intune.remediation.summary
Metrics.Description: Proactive remediation (health script) run outcomes, by script, phase (detection or remediation) and state.

Metrics.Name: intune.script.run_summary
Metrics.Description: Windows PowerShell / macOS shell script run outcomes, by script, OS, target (device or user context) and run state.
